articles.title: Chicago White Sox: Division lead drops to half-game with loss
articles.description: The start of Friday’s Chicago White Sox game against the St. Louis Cardinals at Busch Stadium has been delayed because of incoming poor weather.

articles.title: Chicago White Sox held to 2 hits in 2-0 loss to Pittsburgh Pirates
articles.description: The Chicago White Sox were held to two hits in a 2-0 loss to the Pittsburgh Pirates on Thursday. The Sox were swept in the three-game series and have lost eight of 11.

articles.title: Chicago White Sox: Triple-A trio armed and ready if called up
articles.description: Drew Thorpe, Noah Schultz and David Sandlin are among the pitchers performing well at Triple-A Charlotte who potentially could aid the Chicago White Sox down the stretch.

articles.title: Path to 30 HRs for Chicago White Sox trio of Miguel Vargas, Colson Montgomery and Munetaka Murakami
articles.description: For the first time in 18 years, the Chicago White Sox have three players with at least 30 home runs in the same season: Miguel Vargas, Colson Montgomery and Munetaka Murakami.

articles.title: Chicago baseball report: Cubs’ Dansby Swanson nears return — and White Sox ‘in a good spot’ in playoff chase
articles.description: After a 2-4 trip, the Cubs return home for a pair of series as they battle for a wild-card spot. The White Sox, meanwhile, have their final multicity trip of the season, and it’s a big one.

articles.title: Column: The pressure is on the Chicago White Sox after a drubbing by Pittsburgh tightens the AL Central race
articles.description: The Chicago White Sox are close to pulling off one of the most amazing sports stories in years — and it’s up to manager Will Venable to keep his players from feeling uptight.

articles.title: Chicago White Sox aim to ‘get guys in the best spots’ with rotation tweaks heading into the stretch
articles.description: After Sunday, the Chicago White Sox will have 19 games remaining in the regular season. How the starting pitching performs will play a pivotal role in which team finishes first in the AL Central.

articles.title: Chicago White Sox beat Minnesota Twins 10-1
articles.description: Sam Antonacci had 3 doubles while Randal Grichuk and Kyle Teel homered for the Chicago White Sox in a 10-1 win against the Minnesota Twins on Sunday.
